goals.label: Aims Ethan at sign-ups instead of calls, with a number and a timeframe
Sets a specific reply time for customer emails instead of "try to be quicker"
Agrees what to look at and how often instead of an end-of-month report

objectives.text: Ethan wants to double his calls next month. Agree with him what he should aim for.
objectives.criterion: True when the manager gives Ethan any direction on what to work toward next month: agreeing to double his calls, any sign-up aim, or even a vague steer such as 'just do your best' or 'focus on sign-ups', and Ethan acknowledges it or moves on to the customer email; false for a bare okay, a question alone, or Ethan's words alone.

objectives.text: A customer waited four days for Ethan to reply to her email. Agree with him how to handle customer emails.
objectives.criterion: True when the manager gives any direction on how Ethan should handle customer emails: accepting 'try to be quicker', 'as soon as you can', 'whenever you can', or any reply time, and Ethan acknowledges it or moves on to how they'll know it's working; false for a bare okay, a question alone, or Ethan's words alone.

objectives.text: Agree with Ethan how you'll both know whether it's working.
objectives.criterion: True when the manager gives any direction on how they will keep track: accepting Ethan's end-of-month report, or any regular look together, and Ethan accepts it or the call closes; false for a bare okay or Ethan's words alone.
